description_en: Queries the status of a client certificate or server certificate by its unique identifier
description_zh: 通过证书的唯一识别码查询客户端证书和服务端证书的状态信息
name: DescribeClientCertificateStatus

parameters.help_en:
The unique identifier of the client or server-side certificate that you want to query. Separate multiple identifiers with commas (,).

Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/465990.html to query the unique identifiers of all client and server-side certificates
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的客户端证书或服务端证书的唯一识别码。多个证书识别码之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。


您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/465990.html查询所有客户端与服务端证书的唯一识别码
parameters.name: identifier

CertificateStatus.description_en: The details of the certificate status

RevokeTime.description_en:
The date when the certificate was revoked.

This parameter is returned only when the value of Status is revoked
RevokeTime.description_zh:
证书被吊销的日期。

只有当Status为revoked（表示证书已被吊销）时，才会返回该参数

SerialNumber.description_en: The serial number of the certificate

Status.description_en:
The current status of the certificate. Valid values:

good: The certificate is not revoked.

revoked: The certificate is revoked.

unknown: The server cannot determine the status of the certificate
Status.description_zh:
证书的当前状态。取值：

good：表示该证书未被吊销。
revoked：表示该证书已被吊销。
unknown：表示服务器不能判断该证书的状态
